'''Norund Tac''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked for the [[Merchants Guild]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Tac hired the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to perform a run to [[Firebase Alpha]] in order to provide supplies to a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] that Tac was fronting for.<ref name="Maze-Run" />
